utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what book are we picking next?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d lean toward something gentle this time—maybe a short novel we can all finish without too much strain. I can bring a couple suggestions next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me. Bring the suggestions, and we’ll pick something easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the book club is still on for tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to confirm the time and where we’re meeting before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? Right — I think that’s still happening, unless I missed a change. What were we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it was the mystery one with the red cover? Sorry, I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right to me too — the red-cover mystery. If you find the title, let me know and I’ll bring my copy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think we should keep the book club plan simple this week and maybe pick one short book everyone can finish. If that works, I’ll repeat it to the others and we can set a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that sounds easiest to me. Pick a short one and I’ll help spread the word when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll pick a short book and tell the others we’re keeping it simple this week. Then we can sort out a time once everyone’s heard it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what book club pick are we on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we’re on *The Thursday Murder Club* right now. You’re just in time, grab a seat.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah nice, I’m in — I’ve heard good things about that one. What’s everyone thinking of it so far?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan for the book club—date, time, and the book picked first. Then I can be there and ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s make it easy: next Thursday at 7 pm, and we’re reading "The Vanishing Half." I’ll send the invite out now so you’ve got it all in one place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, that works for me. Thanks for keeping it simple—I’ll be there next Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what book are we reading for the club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure yet — did we settle on a title at the last meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t think we did. Want me to check the notes or pick up where we left off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club’s picking the next novel soon—want me to help you figure out a good one?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules — I’m trying to keep track of which titles are available where, so a shortlist would help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can put together a quick shortlist with where each title’s available and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the book club. What would you like to plan first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — let’s start with the date and the first book, then we can figure out snacks and reminders.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I can help pick a date and suggest a first book. Do you want me to bring a few options for both?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, for book club? I think we’ve got enough tea and snacks for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that’s a relief—then I’ll just bring the book and myself.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that’s all we need—see you tonight!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still deciding whether to go this week, but I’m curious what book they picked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they picked a mystery this time—pretty twisty one, from what I heard. If you go, bring your best guesses!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the book club details again so I can make sure I have them right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — it meets this Thursday at 6:30 at the library, and this time we’re discussing "The Garden Between Stars."

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — so it’s this Thursday at 6:30 at the library, and the book is "The Garden Between Stars," right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery novel this month—pretty twisty so far. I can send you the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, send me the title when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll remind the book club folks about our plan and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’s really helpful. Let me know if you want me to check in with anyone too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll circle back with the book club group and keep you posted. If I need a hand, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club—did we pick the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I was thinking we could choose something lighter this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nice — lighter sounds good. Want me to toss out a couple easy picks?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still new to the book club, but I’d like to hear what you’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve been reading a cozy mystery lately, and the club’s also chatting about a memoir this week. Want me to bring my copy next time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be lovely, thank you. I’d especially like to borrow the cozy mystery and hear what you think about the memoir.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m glad we’re talking book club. What should we plan first: the next pick, the meeting date, or snacks?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the next pick, then we can set the date and snacks around it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — what kind of book are you in the mood for this time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d want to know the date, time, and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the date, time, and meeting place as soon as I have it. I’ll make sure you’re first to know!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — once you’ve got the details, please send them over and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still meeting for book club this Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — we’re still meeting this Thursday for book club.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like that—what’s the plan for the book club this week? If you tell me the time and the book, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to the thread, but I’ll check the time and book and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries—just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m curious—did the book club pick the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but we’re narrowing it down. I’ll let you know as soon as we pick one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that! I’m hearing it’s a pretty good shortlist already, so I’ll be on the lookout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—hi Mara, sorry, I was just thinking about the book club. What were we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re reading "The Book of Goose" this month—if you want, I can remind you of the meeting day too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks — yes please, remind me of the meeting day too. I’d like to actually show up on time for once.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school schedule for book club—what day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday evening works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening works for me too. What time were you thinking?
